verdict.rationale: Publishing clearly exists: the docs refer to 'your published app' with its own MCP server, the CLI can 'deploy resources', and a hands-on user reports building an app in 'two prompts and deploy'. Custom domains with automatic SSL are also documented. However, no evidence explicitly documents a single-step publish action that yields a live URL. Missing for 10: first-party docs describing a one-click publish flow, confirmation of a default live/hosted URL, and independent corroboration of the one-step experience.
